description: The intersection of two \(A\)-definable tuple sets is \(A\)-definable.
signature:
Set.Definable.inter.{u, v, w, u₁} {M : Type w} {A : Set M} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [L.Structure M] {α : Type u₁}
  {f g : Set (α → M)} (hf : A.Definable L f) (hg : A.Definable L g) : A.Definable L (f ∩ g)
